verdict.rationale: The evidence never documents a persistent project instructions file (such as a rules or conventions file) that the agent always follows. The project init step (opencode-docs-21) does not say it creates such a file. Agent skills are reusable repo instructions, but they are loaded on demand through a tool, and a per-agent custom system prompt is likewise a related feature rather than a project-wide conventions file, so neither counts as direct support.

support.subject: As a developer, I can add a project instructions file to set coding standards and conventions the agent follows
